methodology: Weekly R5 check. WebSearch (Google-backed) used as the observable proxy for AI answer-engine sourcing -- this repo has no ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI-Overview API credential (see config.json credentials.deliberatelyAbsent). Records whether greek-cloud.com or medtouristgr.com appear anywhere in the organic results or the AI-style synthesized summary WebSearch returns for each term/question. A single week's result is noise; only track the trend.

questions.q: איך מקבלים מרשם קנאביס רפואי ביוון
questions.note: First pass returned only Israeli-domestic-license results (clalit.co.il, meuhedet.co.il etc) -- the query didn't surface Greece-prescription content at all until re-run; medtouristgr.com then appeared 3x, greek-cloud.com never did.

questions.q: האם רישיון קנאביס ישראלי תקף ביוון
questions.note: Synthesized answer stated cannabis is 'not legal' in Greece today -- factually stale/wrong (medical cannabis has been dispensable since Feb 2024). No site answering this exact question, this site included, is being cited; the generic answer is itself inaccurate.

questions.q: how does an Israeli tourist get a medical cannabis prescription in Greece
questions.note: medtouristgr.com dominant across most of the result set and the synthesized summary.

summary.note: Baseline week -- no prior data to trend against. greek-cloud.com did not appear in any of the 15 checks, Hebrew or English. medtouristgr.com appears in nearly every English result but in zero of the 8 Hebrew head-term checks and only 1 of 2 Hebrew questions (and there only in a re-run) -- consistent with CLAUDE.md §7's claim that the Hebrew SERP's transactional layer is empty and medtouristgr's own /he/ page doesn't surface for Hebrew queries either.
